question:
Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the given group of words.

A person who investigates, reports on, and helps settle complaints
solution:
The correct answer is: **'****Ombudsman'**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Ombudsman"** refers to an official appointed to investigate individuals' complaints against maladministration, especially that of public authorities. (लोकपाल)
 
• **​"Ombudsman"** can also be a person who acts as a trusted intermediary between an organization and some external constituency while representing the broad scope of constituent interests. (लोकपाल)
 
 
• **Example: **The company hired an **ombudsman **to help resolve customer complaints.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 3**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Spokesman** (प्रवक्ता): A person who speaks on behalf of a group or an organization.

 
 
• **Example:** The company's **spokesman **addressed the media regarding the new product launch.
 
 
 
• **Bildungsroman** (शिक्षा उपन्यास): A novel dealing with one person's formative years or spiritual education.
 
 
• **Example: ** "The Catcher in the Rye" is a classic example of a **Bildungsroman**.
 
 
 
• **Superhuman** (अमानवीय): Having or showing exceptional ability or powers.
 
 
• **Example:** The superhero displayed **superhuman **strength in the movie.

The correct answer is: **Option 3**.
